title: Apply for a modified driver licence
summary: Find out how to apply for a modified driver licence if you are 85 or older and feel uncomfortable driving in certain situations.
intro:
If you’re 85 or older and still a competent driver, but you feel uncomfortable driving in certain situations (for example, long distances), visit a service centre and talk to the manager. The manager may suggest a modified licence based on your individual needs. A driving test is not required.

Modified licences can confine your driving to within a certain radius of your home, such as:

Note: If your doctor recommends a modified licence, a driving test is required.
who_can_apply: Being 85 or older and still being a competent driver.
Feeling uncomfortable driving in certain situations (e.g., long distances).
what_you_need: The PDF form: 'Request for a Modified Licence'

how_to_steps.text: Make sure you have the required documentation.
Visit a service centre and submit your application.

faqs.q: Do I need a driving test to get a modified licence?
faqs.a: If you are 85 or older and feel uncomfortable driving in certain situations, you do not need a driving test if you visit a service centre and talk to the manager. However, if your doctor recommends a modified licence, a driving test is required.
Modified licences can confine your driving to within a certain radius of your home.

faqs.q: Where do I submit my application?
faqs.a: You must visit a service centre to submit your application.
